title: Market metrics
intro: How the market is doing against the launch targets, from posting to booking again. Days are counted in {zone}.

targets.title: Launch targets
targets.intro: The first 90 days' targets from the product brief, for the period above.

offer_within_2h.title: Tasks with an offer within 2 h
offer_within_2h.detail: {part} of {whole, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} posted 7 am–9 pm, at least 2 h ago

posted_to_booked.title: Posted tasks that are booked
posted_to_booked.detail: {part} of {whole, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} posted
posted_to_booked.maturing: {count, plural, one {# task is} other {# tasks are}} still open

bookings_completed.title: Confirmed bookings completed
bookings_completed.detail: {part} of {whole, plural, one {# finished booking} other {# finished bookings}}
bookings_completed.maturing: {count, plural, one {# booking is} other {# bookings are}} still under way

bookings_disputed.title: Bookings with a dispute
bookings_disputed.detail: {part} of {whole, plural, one {# confirmed booking} other {# confirmed bookings}} that started

helper_reliability.title: Helper no-shows and late cancellations
helper_reliability.detail: {part} of {whole, plural, one {# confirmed booking} other {# confirmed bookings}} that started (strikes not reversed)

rebook_60d.title: Clients who book again within 60 days
rebook_60d.detail: {part} of {whole, plural, one {# client} other {# clients}} with a completed booking
rebook_60d.maturing: {count, plural, one {# client completed} other {# clients completed}} less than 60 days ago

contribution_per_booking.title: Contribution per booking, before rewards
contribution_per_booking.detail: Estimated over {bookings, plural, one {# completed booking} other {# completed bookings}}
contribution_per_booking.restricted: Money figures are shown to finance and admins.

helpers_id_verified.title: Booked helpers who are ID-verified
helpers_id_verified.detail: {part} of {whole, plural, one {# helper} other {# helpers}} booked, verified before the booking

address_incidents.title: Address exposure incidents
address_incidents.detail: Counted from incident reports, not by the app. Log each one as the safety escalation runbook describes.

funnel.title: From posting to booking again
funnel.intro: The tasks posted in the period, followed to where they got.
funnel.rebookMaturing: {count, plural, one {# task was} other {# tasks were}} completed less than 60 days ago, so the last step can still grow.
funnel.empty: No tasks were posted in this period.

daily.title: Day by day
daily.intro: What happened on each day of the period.
daily.repeatNote: {count, plural, one {# booking was} other {# bookings were}} made by clients who had a completed booking before.

liquidity.title: Liquidity
liquidity.intro: How quickly posted tasks get offers, and how many are booked.
liquidity.empty: No tasks were posted in this period.

rewards.title: Reward spend
rewards.intro: Gift-card rewards against each program's budget and the helpers' monthly cap.
rewards.cap: Each helper can earn up to {cap} a calendar month. This month {atCap, plural, =0 {no helper has} one {# helper has} other {# helpers have}} reached it and {nearCap, plural, =0 {none are} one {# is} other {# are}} at 80% or more.
rewards.restricted: Reward spend is shown to finance and admins.

items.cohort: The funnel and liquidity follow the tasks posted on the board in the period. Book again and regular visits don't post a task, so they count from the booking.
items.booked: A booking counts once it's paid, or once it's booked and charged later.
items.started: Completion, dispute and reliability rates use the confirmed bookings that were due to start in the period.
items.contribution: Contribution is an estimate from the economics in the payments plan: platform fees, less card processing (2.9% + $0.30 of the charge), the payout fee (0.25% + $0.25), $2 a month per paid helper, $0.10 for notifications and 0.5% for losses.
